method: Same machine and compiler; 128 stereo frames per block; alternating baseline/prototype order; median of three runs. WASM in Node/V8, native release executable; browser UI/playback separately verified. Main application sources unchanged.
recommendation: WASM prototype consistently reduced measured block time in all 24 cases. Native timings include three regressions and need further profiling before applying the same optimization there. This is an audit/prototype, not a production change.
parallel_workspace_changes: Other workspace edits appeared during the audit (startup preset selection); they were not modified or incorporated in the captured baseline.
tests: WASM differential: 24 cases at 44.1, 48 and 96 kHz, three comparisons, zero differing samples
Native differential: 24 cases at 44.1, 48 and 96 kHz, three comparisons, zero differing samples
Local browser: interface loaded and played at 48 kHz; output muted for the test; stopped afterward
